 1: export class ImageProviderFactory {
 2:     // Private registry of strategies
 3:     static #registry = new Map();
 4:     /**
 5:      * Registers a new animation strategy.
 6:      * @param {string} key - The name used to identify the animation.
 7:      * @param {class} ImageProviderClass - The class definition.
 8:      */
 9:     static register(key, ImageProviderClass, MediaTorClass) {
10:         this.#registry.set(key, {ImageProviderClass, MediaTorClass});
11:         console.log(`Image Provider registered: ${key}`);
12:     }
13:     /**
14:      * Creates an instance of a registered strategy.
15:      */
16:     static create(key, startegy, config = {}) {
17:         let {ImageProviderClass, MediaTorClass} = this.#registry.get(key);
18:         if (!ImageProviderClass) {
19:             console.warn(`Image Provider "${key}" not found. Falling back to default.`);
20:             // You can return a default or the first one registered
21:             ({ImageProviderClass, MediaTorClass} = this.#registry.values().next().value);
22:         }
23:         if (!ImageProviderClass)
24:             return null;
25:         const provider = new ImageProviderClass(config);
26:         return new MediaTorClass(startegy, provider);
27:     }
28:     static getAvailableTypes() {
29:         return Array.from(this.#registry.keys());
30:     }
31: }

<file path="imageproviders/ImageProviders.js">
 1: import { API } from "../../../../core/HttpClient.js";
 2: import { ResourceManager } from "../../../../domain/StateManager.js";
 3: import { ImageProviderFactory } from "./ImageProviderFactory.js";
 4: import { AudioPlayer } from "../../../../domain/AudioPlayer.js";
 5: import { ApiImageMediator } from "../mediators/ApiImageMediator.js";
 6: import { TrackArtMediator } from "../mediators/TrackArtMediator.js";
 7: class BaseImageProvider {
 8:     getNextImage() {}
 9:     async setup() {}
10:     async _imageLoader(img) {
11:         return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
12:             img.onload = () => resolve(img);
13:             img.onerror = reject;
14:         });
15:     }
16: }
17: export class ApiImageProvider extends BaseImageProvider {
18:     constructor()  {
19:         super()
20:         this.api = new API();
21:         this.imgList = [];
22:         this.imgIdx = 0;
23:     }
24:     async setup() {
25:         await this._loadImageList();
26:     }
27:     async getNextImage() {
28:         console.log('getNextImage')
29:         const img = await this._loadImage();
30:         this.imgIdx = (this.imgIdx + 1) % this.imgList.length;
31:         return img;
32:     }
33:     async _loadImage() {
34:         let img = new Image();
35:         const path = '/' + this.imgList[this.imgIdx].split('/').map(segment => encodeURIComponent(segment)).join('/');
36:         img.src = path;
37:         try {
38:             // We update this.background only after the new image has fully loaded
39:             img = await this._imageLoader(img);
40:         } catch (e) {
41:             console.error(`Failed to load background image at ${path}`, e);
42:             return;
43:         }
44:         return img;
45:     }
46:     async getPreviousImage() {
47:         this.imgIdx = (this.imgIdx - 1 + this.imgList.length) % this.imgList.length; 
48:         return await this._loadImage();
49:     }
50:     async _loadImageList() {
51:         const result = await this.api.loadBGImages();
52:         this.imgList = result['img_list'];
53:     }
54: }
55: export class TrackAlbumArtImageProvider extends BaseImageProvider {
56:     constructor() {
57:         super()
58:         this.img = null;
59:         this.hasChangedTrack = false;
60:     }
61:     async trackChange(track) {
62:         this.hasChangedTrack = false;
63:         // 2. Fetch the new image using your ResourceManager
64:         const url = ResourceManager.getAlbumArtURL(track);
65:         // 3. Load the image object
66:         const img = new Image();
67:         img.src = url;
68:         // 4. Wait for it to load, then assign it to the property 
69:         // the renderer uses (likely this.background or this.img)
70:         this.img = await this._imageLoader(img);
71:         this.hasChangedTrack = true;
72:     }
73:     async getNextImage() {
74:         if (!this.img || !this.hasChangedTrack) return;
75:         this.hasChangedTrack = false;
76:         return await this.img;
77:     }
78: }
79: ImageProviderFactory.register('api-provider', ApiImageProvider, ApiImageMediator);
80: ImageProviderFactory.register('trackart-provider', TrackAlbumArtImageProvider, TrackArtMediator);

<file path="mediators/TrackArtMediator.js">
 1: import { AudioPlayer } from "../../../../domain/AudioPlayer.js"
 2: export class TrackArtMediator {
 3:     constructor(strategy, provider) {
 4:         this.strategy = strategy;
 5:         this.provider = provider;
 6:         this.previousTrack = null;
 7:     }
 8:     async getNextImage() {
 9:         return await this.provider.getNextImage();
10:     }
11:     async setup() {
12:         if (!this.isSubscribed) {
13:             AudioPlayer.onSetCurrentTrackFromTrackList(this._handleNextTrack.bind(this), this);
14:             this.isSubscribed = true;
15:         }
16:         return await this.provider.setup();
17:     }
18:     destroy() {
19:         AudioPlayer.unsubscribeEVent('onSetCurrentTrackFromTrackList', this);
20:     }
21:     async _handleNextTrack(track) {
22:         await this.provider.trackChange(track);
23:         if (this.previousTrack)
24:             this.strategy.triggerTrackChange();
25:         this.previousTrack = track;
26:     }
27: }
</file>

<file path="renderers/ImageRenderer.js">
 1: export class ImageRenderer {
 2:     static render(renderContext, img, transform) {
 3:         const { ctx, canvasWidth, canvasHeight } = renderContext;
 4:         const { scale, alpha, offsetX = 0, offsetY = 0 } = transform;
 5:         // 1. Clear the frame
 6:         ctx.fillStyle = "#181717";
 7:         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
 8:         if (!img) return;
 9:         // 2. Calculate dimensions based on the scale provided by the strategy
10:         const w = img.width * scale;
11:         const h = img.height * scale;
12:         // 3. Center the image
13:         const x = (canvasWidth / 2) - (w / 2) + offsetX; // Apply the glitch shift!
14:         const y = (canvasHeight / 2) - (h / 2) + offsetY;
15:         // 4. Paint
16:         ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
17:         ctx.drawImage(img, x, y, w, h);
18:         ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
19:     }
20: }
</file>

<file path="strategies/AnimationFactory.js">
 1: // AnimationFactory.js
 2: export class AnimationFactory {
 3:     // Private registry of strategies
 4:     static #registry = new Map();
 5:     /**
 6:      * Registers a new animation strategy.
 7:      * @param {string} key - The name used to identify the animation.
 8:      * @param {class} StrategyClass - The class definition.
 9:      */
10:     static register(key, StrategyClass) {
11:         this.#registry.set(key, StrategyClass);
12:         console.log(`Animation registered: ${key}`);
13:     }
14:     /**
15:      * Creates an instance of a registered strategy.
16:      */
17:     static create(key, config = {}) {
18:         const StrategyClass = this.#registry.get(key);
19:         if (!StrategyClass) {
20:             console.warn(`Strategy "${key}" not found. Falling back to default.`);
21:             // You can return a default or the first one registered
22:             const DefaultClass = this.#registry.values().next().value;
23:             return DefaultClass ? new DefaultClass(config) : null;
24:         }
25:         return new StrategyClass(config);
26:     }
27:     static getAvailableTypes() {
28:         return Array.from(this.#registry.keys());
29:     }
30: }
</file>

<file path="strategies/AnimationStrategies.js">
  1: import { BaseProcessor, api } from "../../VisualizerManager.js";
  2: import { AnimationFactory } from "./AnimationFactory.js";
  3: class BaseAnimation {
  4:     constructor(config = {}) {
  5:         this.alphaCoef = 0;
  6:         this.doFadeIn = true;
  7:         this.config = {
  8:             maxAlphaCoef: 2328,
  9:             zoomThreshold: 610,
 10:             fadeSpeed: 10,
 11:             ...config
 12:         };
 13:         this.type = 'random';
 14:     }
 15:     // This replaces the logic inside your process loop
 16:     update() {
 17:         if (this.doFadeIn) {
 18:             this.alphaCoef += this.config.fadeSpeed;
 19:             if (this.alphaCoef >= this.config.maxAlphaCoef) this.doFadeIn = false;
 20:         } else {
 21:             this.alphaCoef -= this.config.fadeSpeed;
 22:             if (this.alphaCoef <= 0) {
 23:                 this.alphaCoef = 0;
 24:                 this.doFadeIn = true;
 25:                 return true; // Signal that the cycle finished (time to swap images)
 26:             }
 27:         }
 28:         return false;
 29:     }
 30:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
 31:         throw new Error("getTransform must be implemented by subclass");
 32:     }
 33: }
 34: export class PulseZoomStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
 35:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
 36:         if (!img)
 37:             return { scale: 0, alpha: 0 };
 38:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
 39:         const coef = (canvasH / img.height) * (1.05 + (this.alphaCoef / 3008));
 40:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
 41:         return { scale: coef, alpha: alpha };
 42:     }
 43: }
 44: // Strategy 2: A simple static fade (no movement)
 45: export class StaticStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
 46:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
 47:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
 48:         const scale = (canvasH / img.height) * 1.05; // Fixed scale
 49:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
 50:         return { scale, alpha };
 51:     }
 52: }
 53: export class GlitchStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
 54:     constructor(config = {}) {
 55:         super(config);
 56:         this.jitterX = 0;
 57:         this.jitterY = 0;
 58:     }
 59:     update() {
 60:         // 1. Run the normal fade in/out logic
 61:         const cycleFinished = super.update();
 62:         // 2. Add some "Randomness"
 63:         // Most of the time (95%), no jitter. 
 64:         // 5% of the time, create a sudden offset.
 65:         if (Math.random() > 0.95) {
 66:             this.jitterX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40; // Shift up to 20px
 67:             this.jitterY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
 68:         } else {
 69:             // Quickly "ease" back to zero jitter
 70:             this.jitterX *= 0.8;
 71:             this.jitterY *= 0.8;
 72:         }
 73:         return cycleFinished;
 74:     }
 75:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
 76:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
 77:         // Base scale + a tiny bit of "shiver" from the jitter
 78:         const scale = (canvasH / img.height) * (1.05 + (Math.abs(this.jitterX) / 2000));
 79:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
 80:         return { 
 81:             scale, 
 82:             alpha,
 83:             // We can pass extra data like offsets to our Renderer!
 84:             offsetX: this.jitterX,
 85:             offsetY: this.jitterY
 86:         };
 87:     }
 88: }
 89: export class PanScanStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
 90:     constructor(config = {}) {
 91:         super(config);
 92:         // We want to track the "horizontal progress"
 93:         this.panProgress = 0;
 94:         this.direction = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
 95:     }
 96:     update() {
 97:         const cycleFinished = super.update();
 98:         // While the image is fading in/staying visible, we move the pan
 99:         // We use a very small increment so it looks smooth
100:         if (this.alphaCoef > 0) {
101:             this.panProgress += 0.001; 
102:         }
103:         // Reset the pan when the image is fully hidden
104:         if (cycleFinished) {
105:             this.direction = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
106:             this.panProgress = 0;
107:         }
108:         return cycleFinished;
109:     }
110:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
111:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
112:         // 1. We scale it slightly larger than the screen so we have "room" to slide
113:         const scale = (canvasH / img.height) * 1.2;
114:         // 2. Standard Alpha logic
115:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
116:         // 3. Calculate the Pan Offset
117:         // We figure out how much "extra" width we have, then multiply by progress
118:         const scaledWidth = img.width * scale;
119:         const extraWidth = scaledWidth - canvas.attribute('width');
120:         // Slide from +extraWidth/2 to -extraWidth/2
121:         const offsetX = (extraWidth / 2) - (this.panProgress * extraWidth);
122:         return { 
123:             scale, 
124:             alpha,
125:             offsetX: offsetX * this.direction,
126:             offsetY: 0 
127:         };
128:     }
129: }
130: export class SmartPanStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
131:     constructor(config = {}) {
132:         super(config);
133:         this.panProgress = 0;
134:         this.direction = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
135:     }
136:     update() {
137:         const cycleFinished = super.update();
138:         // Only progress the pan if we are in a visible state
139:         if (this.alphaCoef > 0) {
140:             this.panProgress += 0.001; 
141:         }
142:         if (cycleFinished) {
143:             this.panProgress = 0;
144:             this.direction = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
145:         }
146:         return cycleFinished;
147:     }
148:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
149:         const canvasW = canvas.attribute('width');
150:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
151:         // 1. "Cover" Logic: Ensure the image at least fills the whole canvas
152:         const scaleW = canvasW / img.width;
153:         const scaleH = canvasH / img.height;
154:         // Use the larger of the two scales so no black bars are visible,
155:         // then add our 1.1 buffer to guarantee room for movement.
156:         const scale = Math.max(scaleW, scaleH) * 1.1; 
157:         const scaledWidth = img.width * scale;
158:         const extraWidth = scaledWidth - canvasW;
159:         // 2. The Pan Logic
160:         // Even if it's portrait, it's now wide enough to slide
161:         const offsetX = (extraWidth / 2) - (this.panProgress * extraWidth);
162:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
163:         return { 
164:             scale, 
165:             alpha, 
166:             offsetX, 
167:             offsetY: 0 
168:         };
169:     }
170: }
171: export class CrossfadeStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
172:     constructor(config = {}) {
173:         super(config);
174:         this.nextAlpha = 0;
175:     }
176:     update() {
177:         // 1. Fade the current one out
178:         if (this.alphaCoef > 0) {
179:             this.alphaCoef -= this.config.fadeSpeed;
180:         }
181:         // 2. Fade the next one in at the same time
182:         this.nextAlpha += this.config.fadeSpeed;
183:         // 3. Cycle ends when the next image is fully opaque
184:         if (this.nextAlpha >= this.config.maxAlphaCoef) {
185:             this.alphaCoef = this.config.maxAlphaCoef; // Reset for next cycle
186:             this.nextAlpha = 0;
187:             return true; 
188:         }
189:         return false;
190:     }
191:     getTransform(canvas, img, isNext = false) {
192:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
193:         const scale = (canvasH / img.height) * 1.05;
194:         // Use the correct alpha depending on if we are drawing the "Outgoing" or "Incoming" image
195:         const targetCoef = isNext ? this.nextAlpha : this.alphaCoef;
196:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, targetCoef)) / 1000;
197:         return { scale, alpha };
198:     }
199: }
200: /**
201:  * Strategy: TrackArtStrategy
202:  * Focuses on a single image (the album art).
203:  * It disables the automatic "fade out" cycle to keep the art visible 
204:  * as long as the track is playing.
205:  */
206: // strategies/AnimationStrategies.js
207: export class TrackArtStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
208:     constructor(config = {}) {
209:         super(config);
210:         this.type = 'track-art';
211:         this.isTrackChanging = false;
212:         this.floatOffset = 0;
213:         this.floatSpeed = 0.02; // Adjust for faster/slower floating
214:     }
215:     update() {
216:         // 1. Handle Track Change Transitions
217:         if (this.isTrackChanging) {
218:             this.alphaCoef -= this.config.fadeSpeed;
219:             if (this.alphaCoef <= 0) {
220:                 this.alphaCoef = 0;
221:                 this.isTrackChanging = false;
222:                 return true; // Signal manager to swap to NEW track art
223:             }
224:         } else if (this.alphaCoef < this.config.maxAlphaCoef) {
225:             this.alphaCoef += this.config.fadeSpeed;
226:         }
227:         // 2. Continuous Floating Animation
228:         // We use a sine wave to create a smooth up/down motion
229:         this.floatOffset += this.floatSpeed;
230:         return false; // Prevent auto-cycling to random images
231:     }
232:     triggerTrackChange() {
233:         console.log('triggerTrackChange');
234:         this.isTrackChanging = true;
235:     }
236:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
237:         if (!img) return { scale: 0, alpha: 0 };
238:         const canvasW = canvas.attribute('width');
239:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
240:         // 1. "Fit" (Contain) Logic
241:         // Calculate scale to fit the image entirely within the canvas
242:         const scaleW = canvasW / img.width;
243:         const scaleH = canvasH / img.height;
244:         const fitScale = Math.min(scaleW, scaleH) * 0.8; // 0.8 adds a nice margin
245:         // 2. Apply Alpha
246:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
247:         // 3. Apply Floating Animation to Y offset
248:         const offsetY = Math.sin(this.floatOffset) * 15; // 15px float range
249:         return { 
250:             scale: fitScale, 
251:             alpha: alpha, 
252:             offsetX: 0, 
253:             offsetY: offsetY 
254:         };
255:     }
256: }
257: AnimationFactory.register('track-art', TrackArtStrategy);
258: AnimationFactory.register('static', StaticStrategy);
259: AnimationFactory.register('pulse-zoom', PulseZoomStrategy);
260: AnimationFactory.register('glitch', GlitchStrategy);
261: AnimationFactory.register('pan-scan', PanScanStrategy);
262: AnimationFactory.register('smart-pan', SmartPanStrategy);
263: AnimationFactory.register('crossfade', CrossfadeStrategy);
</file>
